Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 10  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made the error by incorrectly concluding that "Circus Of Love" was released more recently than "The Kiss Of Evil." This mistake arose from a flawed comparative analysis between the release years of the two films. Despite correctly identifying the release years of "Circus Of Love" as 1954 and "The Kiss Of Evil" (as the American TV title for "The Kiss of the Vampire") as 1963, the Planner erred in inferring which was more recent, possibly confusing the evaluation criteria, thus reaching an illogical conclusion.
